news.title: Treasury Department to buy back up to $6 billion in longer-term debt, triple the normal level
news.summary: The much-anticipated announcement triples the normal buyback operation. It follows an announcement  from Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent. The announcement was made at a press conference in Washington, DC.

news.title: Robinhood CEO says companies can't control how their stock is tokenized as AMC clash escalates
news.summary: Robinhood's Vlad Tenev said public companies can’t control financial products built around their stock. He acknowledged token holders don't get voting rights.

news.title: CoreWeave CEO chalks up public AI pushback to the speed of change: 'And that is frightening'
news.summary: CoreWeave CEO Mike Intrator spoke to CNBC at the Goldman Sachs' Communacopia + Technology Conference this week. Intrator: CoreWeave is a "non-intrusive" technology that can be used in a variety of ways.

news.title: Experts weigh in as researcher says AI has more than 10% chance of 'killing all humans'
news.summary: Anthropic and OpenAI are "gambling with our lives," says Jacob Coxon. Coxon is a co-founder of X, a social-networking site.

news.title: Brent crude oil tops $101 for first time since July as fighting escalates in Persian Gulf
news.summary: Tensions between the U.S. and Iran fueled concerns over further disruptions to Middle East energy supplies. Oil prices extended gains on Wednesday.

news.title: These are the 10 biggest retirement fears — and what you can do about them
news.summary: No amount of wealth can erase retirement worries. No amount of money can erase worries about retirement, says CNN.com's John Sutter.

news.title: Oil at $100? Why you should always have energy stocks in your 401(k).
news.summary: Energy and resource stocks have zigged while the market has zagged. The market has been more focused on the economy than on energy and resources.

news.title: Fed rate hike hinges on two key inflation reports in the next two days
news.summary: Consumer and wholesale prices are rising again. Just how bad does it have to get for the Fed to act? CNN's John Sutter asks.

news.title: Investors worried about rising bond yields are keeping a close eye on this corner of the market
news.summary: U.S. small-cap stocks have hit a pivotal point, trading below a key level. Interest rates in the bond market climb ahead of the Federal Reserve’s highly anticipated policy meeting.
